subject: Admin activity inventory, export timeline & sampling plan
messages:
From: Michael Li <michael.li@lakeshorepharma.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Admin activity inventory request for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Olga,

We are preparing Lakeshore's SIG and CAIQ package and have a couple of outstanding evidence asks around admin activity logging. Can you confirm the exact fields you log for admin actions (what is recorded for each action), your retention windows (hot/nearline/archive), and the available export formats and delivery methods?

Specifics we need for the questionnaire:
- canonical schema for admin actions (field names + types)
- whether ephemeral operator events are included (and if so how they are sampled)
- options for redaction/PII removal prior to export
- a reproducible checksum/manifest approach for verifying exports
- typical turnaround time for an export request and any SLA options

Our SIG review is scheduled for next Wednesday; ideally we would have a sample manifest and a short export by Friday to attach to the submission.

Thanks,
Michael
Security Manager
Lakeshore Pharma

---
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Michael Li <michael.li@lakeshorepharma.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity inventory request for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Michael — thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below, and I attached a small sample CSV and a signed manifest for your reviewers.

What we record for each admin action (canonical):
- timestamp (ISO 8601)
- actor_email / actor_id
- actor_role (e.g., admin, support, system)
- tenant_id (where applicable)
- action_type (string; e.g., "role.update", "policy.change", "api.key.create")
- resource_type (e.g., user, deployment, key)
- resource_id (opaque ID)
- request_id / trace_id
- source_ip
- user_agent
- session_id (if present)
- change_summary (short textual delta; limited to 2,048 chars)
- before_hash / after_hash (sha256 of redacted payload snapshot when applicable)

Retention windows (default):
- hot (searchable): 90 days
- nearline (queryable w/ delay): 365 days
- archive (attested snapshots): up to 7 years on request (subject to contractual agreement)

Export formats & delivery:
- CSV (row-per-action) and newline-delimited JSON (recommended for large exports)
- Exports are staged to S3-compatible URL or delivered via secure SFTP (customer-managed endpoint)
- Each export includes a signed manifest (SHA256 checksums for files) and a signed attestation (timestamped)

Sampling and ephemeral events: we include ephemeral/operator events by default in the hot window; for exports we can do a deterministic sampling policy (e.g., 100% for admin.role.* and policy.*; 10% for low-risk operator heartbeats). Sampling method is seeded by tenant_id + day so results are reproducible for audits.

PII/redaction options:
- Field-level redaction (replace with tokenized placeholder) prior to export
- Hashing sensitive fields with per-delivery salt (we can provide the salt format for attestation)
- Redaction rules are configurable per-account and applied during export, with a redaction manifest attached.

Turnaround & SLA:
- Sample export (<= 10k rows): 48–72 business hours after request and acceptance of export handshake (SFTP creds or presigned URL).
- Full exports (multi-GB): planned job with timeline depending on size; typical SLA quoted in dedicated engagements.

Attachments included: admin_action_manifest_sample.csv (sample 20-row extract), admin_actions_export_manifest.sha256 (signed).

Next steps:
1) Confirm the exact timeframe you need (you mentioned next Wednesday) — we can provide the sample CSV by Friday EOD PT.
2) Please confirm preferred delivery (SFTP endpoint or presigned S3).
3) Approve inclusion of Ben Carter (compliance) and Jordan Blake (ops) on the export handshake so they can generate the export and key the manifest.

If that works I'll route to Ben and Jordan.

Best,
Olga
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: admin_action_manifest_sample.csv (CSV, 20 rows)
Attachment: admin_actions_export_manifest.sha256 (text)

Folks — forwarding the thread with Michael at Lakeshore. Action items below (timeline target: sample deliverable by today EOD).

Action items:
1) Ben: prepare the redaction manifest and confirm salt format for salted-hash of actor_email. We will put the salt in the signed attestation but not in the CSV. Attestation should say: hashing algorithm = sha256, salt format = tenant_uuid:YYYYMMDD, and include a keyed HMAC over the salt+manifest.
2) Jordan: prepare an SFTP staging location and a minimal ACLed user for lakeshore; generate SSH host key fingerprint and share in the manifest. If SFTP not preferred, generate presigned S3 links and the accompanying manifest.
3) Export job: scope = sample (20 rows) including at least 3 admin.role.* events and 5 ephemeral/heartbeat events; include before_hash/after_hash columns and the change_summary column.

Export packaging checklist (for your use):
- files: admin_action_sample.csv (ndjson ok), admin_actions_export_manifest.sha256, redaction_manifest.json, attestation.sig (PKCS7)
- manifest fields: file_name, row_count, sha256(file), exported_at (ISO), exporter (internal id), sftp_path or s3_url, host_key_fingerprint
- signed attestation: signed by internal export key and timestamped

I uploaded the sample CSV and a preliminary manifest to the secure drive link (internal): https://redwood.example.com/drive/admin-evidence-template (shared with Lakeshore). Michael: once Ben/Jordan confirm, please confirm you can accept SFTP or presigned S3.

Thanks — pushing to close this for the SIG packet.

—Olga
